subject: designing a question
body:
Goodafternoon,

 

I’m designing a questionnaire in which one question should only be asked once a week (this is a voice memo question). I don’t know how to do this via contrasts but also can’t find this online so I was wondering if you could help me with that.

 

Met vriendelijke groet,

Milou de Zeeuw (zij/haar)

subject: designing a question
body:
Hi Milou,
You need to set a Time-based trigerring logic.
To do that, from top right of your activity editor, click on "Triggering Logic"

Then click on "Time"

Now in the newly created section you can either choose to prompt the voice memo relative to the date/time the participant joined your study or on an absolute date/time (e.g on Tuesdays 11 a.m. regardless of when the participant joined the study). Please note that the latter might result in some participants missing a number of activities.
Now that you have set the date/time you need to set the repetition for that activity.


Finally, you can specify if you want the activity to be continuously prompted until the end of study period or if you want it to end after a set number of repeats.
Please let me know if it helped you or if you need further help with this matter.
Best regards,
Amin

subject: designing a question
body:
Hi Milou

Sorry for the late reply. Can you please elaborate more? My assumption is that you have created a survey where there's only one question and the participants are supposed to record a voice memo. In this case, you should be fine following my steps. If that didn't work, please let me know what's the issue.

However, If your survey has more than one question, you CANNOT set triggering logic just for one question and not the rest. The triggering logic applies to a survey in whole. If this is the case I highly recommend creating different surveys, one for the voice memo and another one for the rest.

Please let me know if I misunderstood your issue.


Best regards,
Amin
